two_stage_plan: Stage A: real ComfyUI 384x384 ImageScale -> Pony checkpoint VAEEncode -> VAEDecode; save actual resized reference and decoded roundtrip, with NO KSampler or motion model.

Calculate RGB PSNR, SSIM and MAE against exact ComfyUI resized reference. Conservative automated quality gate: PSNR >=22dB AND SSIM>=0.78 AND MAE<=13/255. This is a heuristic, not visual approval; if it fails stop with comparative image and private report.

Only if gate passes and ComfyUI queue idle/VRAM adequate: M3c short AnimateDiff SDXL 8x384, denoise 0.38, CFG 4.5, seed 20260925, identical M3b prompt/image/motion/sampler; change ONLY KSampler steps from 10 to 20; 8 PNG + MP4.

Compare source M2, ComfyUI-resized 384, no-motion VAE roundtrip, prior M3b first frame, and new M3c first/last frames in user report. If visually still poor, next distinguish static img2img vs motion conditioning before RIFE/upscale.
